mainEntity.name: Why does record retrieval strategy matter in a records matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: The practical point is that Brazil immigration work usually turns on how well the documents support the facts, not only on whether a person believes they qualify. In real cases, record retrieval strategy changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.
